[P3] Move only entries for packages being released

This instruction moves every pending entry during any release. However, `[Unreleased]` includes Extras and Compute Worker changes, and the publishing script explicitly excludes those packages. Following this during a Core release would label their changes as shipped and remove them from the pending list. Scope this step and its checklist item to the package versions actually being published, leaving other entries under `[Unreleased]`.
